title: customizations.menagerie
description: What a workspace needs from Wyrwood and Xolotl, declared in its rendered devcontainer definition.

accessGroup.description: Numeric group ID applied to the consumer directory and sockets. The container's user must have it.

policies.description: Names of Wyrwood policies to bind, each on the operator key's allowlist.

values.description: Per-binding values that the bound policies read. A value cannot hold a wildcard, a slash or a dot, so it cannot widen a path.

xolotl.description: The workspace's Xolotl client key. Absent, Menagerie issues no key.

keyPolicy.description: The Xolotl policy of the key.

keyName.description: The key's name in that policy.
